summary: DB connection pool exhaustion during a flash sale traffic spike.
resolution: Restarted the connection pool and temporarily raised max pool size.
outcome: Resolved in 6 minutes, no data loss.

summary: Connection pool exhaustion caused by a slow downstream payment provider.
resolution: Restarting the pool alone did not help; required a circuit breaker fix in code.
outcome: Required engineering follow-up, not a clean auto-fix.

summary: Feature-vector cache grew unbounded and OOM-killed the pod repeatedly.
resolution: Rolled back to previous image; root cause was a cache eviction bug.
outcome: Required a rollback, not something safe to automate blindly.
